    # Insert after docstring or shebang
    lines = content.split('\n')
    insert_idx = 0
    in_docstring = False
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if '"""' in line:
            if in_docstring:
                insert_idx = i + 1
                in_docstring = False
                break
            else:
                in_docstring = True
                continue
        if not in_docstring and i < 3 and (line.startswith('#!') or line.strip() == ''):
            insert_idx = i + 1
    lines.insert(insert_idx, env_block)
    with open(fpath, 'w') as f:
        f.write('\n'.join(lines))
    print(f'{fpath}: patched at line {insert_idx}')
PYEOF
